findings.title: Absent capacity evidence is serialized as a measured zero SOH/capacity
findings.mechanism: No valid history and unavailable/invalid live signals leave currentCapacityWh and currentSOH at zero. Nonnullable DTO numbers serialize those defaults as 0, and the finite guard accepts them: the UI can show 0%/Degraded and zero capacity even though no pack-capacity measurement exists.
findings.bounded_follow_up: Health response availability for current_soh/estimated_capacity_wh, its no-evidence branches, corresponding energy types and this page's unknown-state handling. Preserve genuinely supplied zero; do not guess capacity.
findings.limit: Conditional source path proven; no assertion that a real vehicle currently takes it.

findings.title: Empty denominators still yield optimal habits and perfect cycle-depth scores
findings.mechanism: percentage returns 0 for totalCount<=0; habit scoring starts at 100 and stress defaults Low. Missing drive DoD stays the summary struct's 0, producing cycleDepthScore=100. The banner ratio correctly remains unknown, but other panels can call the same empty sample optimal, zero full-charge exposure, and excellent habits. Generated fallback recommendations also praise habits without a sample.
findings.bounded_follow_up: Expose valid charge/DoD denominators and unavailable scores in this Health contract; gate only dependent values/advice, retaining all shells and actual zero counts.
findings.limit: No database query or empty production sample was executed.

findings.title: Missing thermal evidence becomes a fabricated 25 C risk detail
findings.mechanism: Health substitutes avgTempC=25 when no thermal average exists and still computes a temperature risk. temperatureExposure separately returns null for absent/fewer-than-ten samples. Consequently the risk card can state Average cell temperature: 25.0 C/Low while the temperature health-factor card says unavailable.
findings.bounded_follow_up: Carry thermal sample availability into computeRiskFactors and the Health thermal DTO; keep unknown temperature risk neutral instead of asserting a default observation.

findings.title: Temperature-risk badge reverses the physical sign
findings.mechanism: Backend temperatureExposure is risk: <=30 C yields 10, >45 C yields 90. The health-factor badge uses the high-is-good scoreVariant, coloring 90 success and 10 danger, while adjacent copy says lower is better. Risk-factor cards elsewhere use the correct low-is-good thresholds.
findings.bounded_follow_up: Only the temperature health-factor badge's severity mapping and its boundary cases; do not invert charge-habit or cycle-depth scoring.

findings.title: Flat/improving fits can predict reaching 80% in approximately zero years
findings.mechanism: HasEnoughData becomes true before fit-identifiability checking. A nonnegative slope, degenerate timestamps, or past threshold leaves nonnullable years_to_80_pct at 0. The page gates only on has_enough_data and treats zero as a finite crossing time. Both the backend summary and fit KPI apply abs(slope), so improving fits are also presented as positive degradation.
findings.bounded_follow_up: Prediction fit-validity/crossing-availability/sign contract and its consumers in this page/stats; preserve signed fitted evidence and distinguish no future crossing, already below threshold and insufficient fit.

findings.title: Nominal capacity estimate provenance is hidden behind rated/usable-capacity terminology
findings.mechanism: The SOH denominator is a VIN/model estimate or 75000 Wh default, not an established original-rated pack measurement. Current capacity is independently estimated from recent charge aggregates/live energy divided by SOC. The wire exposes original_capacity_wh and capacity_source but this presentation does not consume them; help says usable/rated capacity and capacity derived from SOH. Generic estimate caveat is useful but omits which nominal assumption drives the ratio.
findings.bounded_follow_up: Display exact capacity_source/original_capacity_wh evidence in the existing brief/help and distinguish nominal assumption from observed estimator; actual calibration remains candidate BD-C01.

findings.title: Battery age is observation-window age, not verified pack age
findings.mechanism: batteryAgeMonths chooses the earliest retained history/first charging/first drive timestamp. It does not use manufacture, installation or replacement date, and returns 0 with no history. The UI labels it Battery age. This can materially understate older/replaced packs and feeds cycle-rate estimates.
findings.bounded_follow_up: Name and provenance of this observation duration in the Health response and existing age metric; do not infer true pack age from telemetry start.

findings.title: Cycle/DoD help describes different quantities from the backend
findings.mechanism: Backend total_cycles is integer round(sum charge energy/nominal capacity); the frontend comments/help describe fractional full-pack equivalents. Avg DoD is an unweighted average SOC drop per drive, not depth per charge/discharge cycle as help says. Valid drive count and throughput basis are not exposed alongside these modeled wear metrics.
findings.bounded_follow_up: Align only these two Health metric definitions, precision/type and sample explanations; do not silently relabel per-drive SOC changes as full battery cycles.

findings.title: Original range is the first retained sample; missing history signals become zero
findings.mechanism: History is at most the latest 180 qualifying daily samples, ascending. The frontend takes history[0].range_m as a constant Original range, so it is not an original/new-pack baseline. SQL coalesces missing range/odometer to 0 and accepts arbitrarily earlier signal readings before day end; finite zero is then plotted/formatted as observed range/odometer.
findings.bounded_follow_up: Relabel the retained comparison baseline and preserve missingness/sample timestamp in the range/odometer history contract; do not replace a missing baseline with a nominal invented range.

findings.title: Projection join copies an old observation into a later row labeled Actual health
findings.mechanism: The first projection is dated from current server month. Page proj[0].health is assigned the last historical SOH even if that observation predates the month. The accessible/exported Actual health column now contains the old observation at a new date, not merely a visual continuity marker.
findings.bounded_follow_up: Separate graphical join coordinates from exported/accessible observed data in projectionChartData; retain actual observation date and do not fabricate a new health sample.

findings.title: 95% confidence wording overstates the implemented approximate prediction interval
findings.mechanism: The interval uses sqrt(1+1/n+xDev^2/ssx), a prediction-interval expression, with fixed multiplier 2 for n<=30 and 1.96 otherwise. For the allowed n=3 fit, it is not the 95% Student-t interval with n-2 degrees of freedom. UI/ARIA name it 95% confidence without describing approximation or denominator.
findings.bounded_follow_up: Clarify this exact interval's terminology and sample basis or correct multiplier/model contract; empirical calibration is separately unmeasured in BD-C01.

findings.title: Dated analytics have no workspace-range/both-bounds contract
findings.mechanism: Actual /battery-degradation route is range:false/vehicle:true. Page does not consume useRangeState and hook supplies only vehicle_id. Health ignores from/to: capacity has a 180-row bound, charge/drive summary is lifetime, thermal summary is fixed 90 days and recent charging analysis is limited to 100 sessions. Thus rolling/custom/shared-timezone date bounds do not scope these sections.
findings.bounded_follow_up: Parent must decide whether this page is explicitly lifetime/bounded history or a workspace-range owner. If adopting the latter, separately claim only workspace route registration, page/hook both-bound/cache operands and Health query bounds. Do not add a duplicate date picker or client-only filtering.
findings.limit: This is a source contract/policy gap, not a newly introduced regression or endpoint mismatch; this QA authorizes no endpoint changes.

findings.title: UTC date-only observations are rendered through browser-timezone instants
findings.mechanism: Backend dates are YYYY-MM-DD UTC day keys. formatDate parses them with new Date and uses toLocaleDateString without the configured timezone/locale options. In a browser zone west of UTC a day key displays as the previous calendar day. Projection months/predicted dates are separately rendered raw, so date representations are inconsistent and bypass saved display-timezone settings.
findings.bounded_follow_up: Use the existing calendar-day/date-preference boundary for this page's history/table labels and distinguish projection month keys; no source timestamps should be shifted or rewritten.
findings.limit: Conditional platform/date mechanism identified; no browser timezone scenario was executed.

findings.title: Retained data warning is correct globally but evidence briefs still claim available readings
findings.mechanism: BatteryEvidenceBrief supports retained=true and corresponding warning label/tone. BatteryDegradationStats accepts only data/loading/prediction and never forwards retained state from healthState. After failed/paused refresh, data remains visible with the correct page warning but each populated evidence brief defaults to Available source readings.
findings.bounded_follow_up: Forward the existing retained/trust classification through the two direct degradation stats call sites and adapter; retain payload, shared status owner and global warning.

findings.title: Null-array safety does not validate malformed rows, scores or wire collections
findings.mechanism: Type assertions and ?? [] do not reject a non-array history/projections/risk_factors or null row. .map/property access/rf.name.replace can throw. Nonfinite history SOH takes danger rather than neutral; nonfinite health-factor scores and unknown stress enums similarly take a semantic verdict. Negative/out-of-domain range/SOH/counts are not consistently guarded. The gauge/range finite guards are useful but not a complete payload boundary.
findings.bounded_follow_up: Validate only the consumed BatteryHealthAnalytics nested arrays/rows/numeric domains and render unknown values neutrally; preserve valid zero and independent panel shells. No generalized shared validator rewrite.
findings.limit: Malformed payload acceptance paths are source-visible; neither production malformed traffic nor a crash was observed.

findings.title: Server-authored risk prose and recommendations bypass translation
findings.mechanism: Static UI labels use t, including translated risk identities. But rf.label, rf.detail and recommendation strings are rendered raw, while the backend constructs English prose and Celsius text. The risk temperature detail therefore also ignores a saved Fahrenheit display preference.
findings.bounded_follow_up: This Health response's recommendation/risk message codes, typed measurement operands and page translation/display boundary only; no catalog-wide campaign. Existing human-readable fallback content must remain.
findings.technical_identifier_exemption: capacity_source, risk names and insufficient_data reason are technical identifiers; their untranslated spelling alone is not counted as an English-prose violation.

findings.title: Unused charging-habits energy field is kWh on the otherwise SI Health wire
findings.mechanism: Health divides summary.avgEnergyWh by 1000 before serializing avg_energy_per_session. The opaque wire name/type does not declare Wh and its value is kWh, unlike capacity_wh/ac_energy_wh/dc_energy_wh. This page does not display the field, so no current rendered capacity conversion bug is asserted.
findings.bounded_follow_up: Parent-owned separate SI contract correction for this one field and explicitly identified consumers; no broad battery/telemetry migration in this QA.
